content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Government engineering and operations contractor; it does not run auctions or sell used equipment for owners."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Runs online auctions selling used salvage assets on behalf of sellers to dealers and exporters, matching RB Global's model."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Consumer marketplace for handmade and vintage goods with fixed-price listings, not industrial equipment auctions."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and charters dry bulk ships, a shipping business with no auction or equipment resale model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Buys and resells furniture and home goods as inventory, a distributor model rather than auctions on owners' behalf."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Provides trucking and freight transportation for shippers, a logistics service rather than asset sales."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and construction services delivered by professionals, not an asset marketplace or auction business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contracting and building system maintenance, a construction services business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and media agency fees for brands, a marketing services business."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Operates wholesale vehicle auctions and an online marketplace where sellers and buyers pay fees, closely matching RB Global."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates dry bulk ships carrying cargo, a shipping business rather than auctions of equipment."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"On-site industrial inspection and repair services for plant operators, a field service business."}]}
